title: core.org.created
description: An organization was created (signup or operator). Carries the settings a projection needs to interpret dates and money for it: `timezone` (IANA; account defaults it to Asia/Kolkata), `currency`, and `fiscal_year_start_month` (1-12; account defaults it to 4, April).
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I1): services/account/app/services.py:create_organization does not emit fiscal_year_start_month yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
